name: Meeting Notes
author: kvango
tagline: Record any call. Clean notes land in your notebook.
description: Records your microphone and the far side of a call as two streams, transcribes locally with Whisper, and writes structured notes — TL;DR, decisions, action items, open questions — plus the full transcript. Nothing leaves your Mac.

notes: Installs the BlackHole audio driver, which needs your admin password.
Asks a few questions in the terminal, including an optional email address.
Installs llama.cpp — LocalBook will point the tool at its own engine afterwards, so nothing needs to load a second model.
